lpp-zip.name: lpp-zip
lpp-zip.description: ZIP archive create/read library — pure L++ using buf_* primitives
features: Create ZIP archives with multiple files
Read ZIP archives and extract entries
CRC32 verification
STORE method (no compression)
Pure L++ — no C code, no linker changes

api.zip_add_file: (archive: Int, filename: Str, content: Str) — add file to archive
api.zip_save: (archive: Int, path: Str) — write ZIP to disk
api.zip_open: (path: Str) -> Int — open ZIP file for reading
api.zip_entry_name: (handle: Int, index: Int) -> Str — get entry filename
api.zip_entry_data: (handle: Int, index: Int) -> Str — get entry content

lppdb.name: lppdb
lppdb.description: A real embedded SQL database engine in pure L++: binary page storage, typed cells, real parser/executor, disk persistence. Replaces the former non-functional sqlite stub.
features: Real binary page-oriented storage persisted to disk (buf_read/buf_write)
Typed cells: INTEGER (8-byte LE), TEXT (length-prefixed), NULL
Real SQL tokenizer/parser/executor - results computed from stored data
CREATE TABLE, INSERT (multi-row, explicit columns), SELECT (*, columns)
Aggregates COUNT(*)/SUM/MIN/MAX computed over matching rows
WHERE (=,!=,<>,<,<=,>,>=, AND), ORDER BY ASC/DESC, LIMIT
UPDATE ... SET ... WHERE, DELETE FROM ... WHERE, DROP TABLE
Persistence verified across close/reopen
Works with --linker host and zero-dependency --linker direct
Pure L++ over buf_* builtins - no C code, no linker changes

api.db_open: (path: Str) -> Int - open or create a database file
api.db_exec: (handle: Int, sql: Str) -> Str - run a statement, returns JSON
api.db_save: (handle: Int, path: Str) - flush to disk

limitations: No FTS, views, triggers, indexes, or transactions
Linear row scan (no B-tree); not for very large tables
Own binary format - NOT SQLite file-format compatible
